statement: Three elaborate coloured containers stand at left, beside several rows of separate root and foliage drawings. Top-row nearby inscriptions were matched to transcription lines; overlapping middle and lower drawings have uncertain label attachment. Descriptions do not identify species.

features.description: Upper left tall red cylindrical container with green neck and a flared foot.
Middle left red tiered container with a pointed lid, green lower section and feet.
Lower left red tiered container with green narrow neck and round base.
Upper row: pale elongated root with divided narrow stalks and green wash above.
Upper row: dark brown tapering root below a pale stalk.
Upper row: brown collar with multiple long thin roots and upright stems.
Upper row: two brown oval lobes with thin pale branching roots.
Upper row: pale tangled roots and stems with green wash above.
Upper right: a single elongated pointed green leaf on a curving stalk.
Middle left: large twisted branching brown and pale roots, with green lobed foliage above.
Middle left centre: small dark root with long pale branches beside a narrow green serrated form.
Middle centre: pale collar with reddish branching roots and green foliage.
Middle right centre: pale spotted bulbous form with brown and pale roots.
Middle right: curved branching stem with multiple separate elongated green leaves.
Lower centre: a crown with several narrow green edged leaves and long reddish branching roots.
Lower right: several round scalloped green leaves attached to a very long pale branching root.
Bottom edge: elongated green leaves attached to a pale base and long reddish tapered root, partly cut off by page edge.
